2. WC + shower · WC + ฝักบัว

4. Indoor fitness studio (lease) · สตูดิโอฟิตเนส
5. Outdoor fitness terrace · ลานฟิตเนสกลางแจ้ง

text.tspan: L3 = FITNESS: one indoor studio for a single tenant (78.0 m², pilates reformer / functional / yoga — no heavy drop-lifting) + outdoor terrace 30.0 m² linked
through a sliding glass wall. Same program as REV E.
ARRIVAL: S1 continues in the same footprint (stacked U-stair, 40 risers × 0.175 = 7.00): flight 21–30 north row → landing +5.25 → flight 31–40 south row
→ floor landing +7.00 → north-wall door into the lobby. Open well beside the landing has a 1.10 guard.
R44: Sky Trail (long stairs at E/5) REMOVED on request — terrace closed by a 1.10 m guard on all sides. S1 is the only stair of L3 (allowed: 3 storeys,
no roof deck, ≤ 40 m travel, 1.20 m clear).
WET: only the WC + shower at the north-west corner; its drain drops outside the north façade next to S1 (same riser line as the L2 WC). Old west core and
lift are removed; tenant store takes their place.
NO LIFT: L3 not wheelchair-accessible. Structure of L3 (new floor on top of the existing L2 slab) to be confirmed by the structural engineer.
